title: gated behavioural-verification predicate v0.1
description: Predicate for predicateType https://gated.dev/attestations/behavioural-verification/v0.1. Provenance CLASS is encoded in the field path: attested.* is read from published SIGNED artifacts (a stranger reproduces it exactly); derived.* is computed by the projector and MUST carry source_fields + recipe; declared.* is operator-asserted and NOT evidenced by the published record. A derived field without a recipe is the built-not-bound pattern reappearing inside the fix for it — hence source_fields and recipe are REQUIRED here, not conventional.

statement_id.description: <board_id>/<cell_id> — disambiguates Statements that share a subject digest.

attested.description: MEASURED tier: every field traceable to a published signed receipt or manifest. PLACEHOLDER POLICY (differs from declared.* deliberately): NEVER emit a placeholder here — anything unverifiable does not belong in this block at all, so a null would be a slot pretending to be evidence. Compare declared.*, which ALWAYS emits (its purpose is to name what is not evidenced). additionalProperties is false because a loose schema would let a future computed field arrive in a measured slot without failing validation — that is the class law leaking.

result_kind.description: The gate's OWN vocabulary — never a re-labelled summary.

measurement.description: What was actually measured — this is what makes the attestation behavioural rather than a status bit.

corpus_version.description: A VERSION STRING, not a digest — see stability_note residual (2).

declared.description: OPERATOR-ASSERTED tier: NOT evidenced by the published record, so NOT stranger-reproducible. Excluded from the stranger-simulation comparison by construction. PLACEHOLDER POLICY: ALWAYS emit each field (null value + evidenced_by_record:false + note) — omitting would hide the residual and leave a reader unable to distinguish 'inapplicable' from 'unavailable'. This is the OPPOSITE of attested.*, deliberately.

derived.description: COMPUTED tier: re-derivable by a stranger from attested.* via the stated recipe, but NEVER emitted by the gate.

trust_root.description: Machine-readable enum a policy can route on — NOT baked into the predicateType URI, which would freeze a transient trust posture into a permanent type.
